historySize.Name: History size
historySize.Hint: How many navigation steps to remember.

reopenClosed.Name: Reopen closed sheets
reopenClosed.Hint: When going back to a sheet that has since been closed, reopen it. If disabled, closed sheets are skipped.

forwardButton.Name: Use mouse Forward button
forwardButton.Hint: Mouse Forward goes forward again after going back.

captureBrowserBack.Name: Capture browser Back (Alt+Left)
captureBrowserBack.Hint: Also catch the browser's own Back navigation (Alt+Left, the browser's Back button) so it steps back through sheets instead of leaving the game.
